remarks: Charming Condo in Prime Location! Tucked away in a small, well-maintained complex, this bright and inviting home offers the perfect blend of comfort and convenience. Ideally situated near I-95 and within walking distance of Holly Pond in Darien, enjoy easy access to the beach, scenic waterfront views, and all that coastal living has to offer. Step inside to beautiful hardwood floors that flow throughout the space, complemented by an updated kitchen and bathroom designed for modern living. The generously sized bedroom provides a tranquil retreat, filled with natural light. Additional perks include coin-operated laundry and storage in the basement, reserved parking, and ample visitor spaces. Surrounded by stunning landscaping, this hidden gem is a rare find for those seeking charm, location, and accessibility. Don't miss out on this fantastic opportunity!
